_comment: Egg: Hermes Agent Gateway (full agent, 24/7). Installs Hermes into the server dir so it persists across Pterodactyl containers, writes .env/config at runtime, and runs `hermes gateway` in the foreground. Uses cloud inference (Ollama Cloud / OpenCode Zen) so no local GPU/RAM for the model is needed.
name: Hermes Agent Gateway
author: azascloud-cell
description: Runs the full Hermes Agent gateway (Telegram) persistently on a Pterodactyl server. Cloud inference via Ollama Cloud / OpenCode Zen. Allocate ~512MB-1GB RAM.

installation.script:
# @author azascloud-cell
# @description Hermes Agent Gateway egg installer

apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl git

# Install into /mnt/server (becomes /home/container at runtime) so
# ~/.hermes persists across the separate install/runtime containers.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Ensure PATH for the install

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.hermes/bin:$PATH"

echo "Installing Hermes Agent..."
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- --skip-setup --skip-browser --skip-computer-use || true

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.hermes/bin:$PATH"
UV="$HOME/.hermes/bin/uv"
VENV_PY="$(ls -d $HOME/.hermes/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
if [ -n "$VENV_PY" ] && [ -x "$UV" ]; then
  echo "Pinning python-telegram-bot 22.6..."
  "$UV" pip install --python "$VENV_PY" --reinstall "python-telegram-bot[webhooks]==22.6" || true
fi

# Patch Telegram TypeHandler restoration (hermes-agent#85421)
ADAPTER="$HOME/.hermes/hermes-agent/plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py"
if [ -f "$ADAPTER" ]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path(os.environ["HOME"]) / ".hermes/hermes-agent/plugins/platforms/telegram/adapter.py"
if not p.exists():
    raise SystemExit(0)
src = p.read_text()
if "TypeHandler as _TH" in src:
    print("already patched")
    raise SystemExit(0)
old = "            MessageHandler as _MH,\n            ContextTypes as _CT, filters as _filters,\n        )"
new = "            MessageHandler as _MH,\n            ContextTypes as _CT, TypeHandler as _TH, filters as _filters,\n        )"
if old in src:
    src = src.replace(old, new)
old2 = "    TelegramMessageHandler = _MH\n    ContextTypes = _CT\n    filters = _filters"
new2 = "    TelegramMessageHandler = _MH\n    TypeHandler = _TH\n    ContextTypes = _CT\n    filters = _filters"
if old2 in src:
    src = src.replace(old2, new2)
old3 = "    global CommandHandler, CallbackQueryHandler, TelegramMessageHandler\n    global ContextTypes, filters, ParseMode, ChatType, HTTPXRequest"
new3 = "    global CommandHandler, CallbackQueryHandler, TelegramMessageHandler, TypeHandler\n    global ContextTypes, filters, ParseMode, ChatType, HTTPXRequest"
if old3 in src:
    src = src.replace(old3, new3)
p.write_text(src)
print("patched TypeHandler restoration")
PY
fi

# Runtime start script: writes .env + config.yaml from panel vars, then runs gateway.
cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.hermes/bin:$PATH"
export HERMES_HOME="$HOME/.hermes"

mkdir -p "$HOME/.hermes"
cat > "$HOME/.hermes/.env" <<EOF
OLLAMA_API_KEY=${OLLAMA_API_KEY}
OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY=${OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY}
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}
TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS=${TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS}
EOF

cat > "$HOME/.hermes/config.yaml" <<EOF
model:
  provider: "${MODEL_PROVIDER}"
  default: "${DEFAULT_MODEL}"
  base_url: "${BASE_URL}"
EOF

echo "Starting Hermes gateway..."
exec hermes gateway
SH
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh

echo "Hermes Agent Gateway installed."

variables.description: API key from https://opencode.ai/auth (env var OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY)
